newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder July operating revenue rises.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder July operating revenue rises.

text.p: Knight-Ridder Inc said on Tuesday its operating revenues for July increased 12.4 percent to $236.5 million from the comparable period a year ago.

The operating revenue figures exclude results from Detroit -- where a newspaper strike has been under way since July 13, 1995 -- and its Knight-Ridder Financial unit, which was sold during July 1996, the company said.

On a pro forma basis as if the company had acquired Contra Costa Newspapers before July 1995, total operating revenue for July 1996 increased 6.6 percent, the company said. Pro forma revenue excluded Detroit and Knight-Ridder Financial.
Knight-Ridder's total July revenue increased 3.4 percent to $237.3 million, compared with $229.6 million in July 1995.
In the year-to-date period, total revenue increased 3.8 percent to $1.65 billion, compared with $1.59 billion in the first seven months of 1995.
Total July newspaper revenue surged 12.4 percent to $210.9 million from $187.7 million in the 1995 period.
Year-to-date newspaper revenue increased 6.7 percent to $1.38 billion from $1.29 billion in the comparable period a year ago.
